让 FSR3 直接写入用于 GLES 呈现的 AHardwareBuffer，: Lets FSR3 write directly to the AHardwareBuffer used for GLES presentation,

依赖异步流水线；驱动不支持外部存储图像时自动回退。默认关闭。: Requires async. Falls back if external storage images are unsupported. Off by default.

用 GPU 复制 renderbuffer 代替每帧 CPU 读回；失败时关闭并: Copies renderbuffers on the GPU instead of CPU readback. Disable on failure.
